subject: general
question: Who were the judges of the special bench that ordered an immediate ban on manual scavenging and sewer cleaning in metropolitan cities in early 2025?

options.text: Justice DY Chandrachud and Justice Hima Kohli
Justice UU Lalit and Justice Sanjay Kishan Kaul
Justice Sudhanshu Dhulia and Justice Aravind Kumar
Justice Ranjan Gogoi and Justice NV Ramana

solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice Sudhanshu Dhulia and Justice Aravind Kumar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In a landmark ruling in **early 2025**, a special bench of the **Supreme Court of India** consisting of **Justice Sudhanshu Dhulia** and **Justice Aravind Kumar** ordered an **immediate ban** on the practice of manual scavenging and manual sewer cleaning in **metropolitan cities**.
 
• The bench emphasized that the continuation of such a practice is a grave violation of the **fundamental rights** guaranteed under the **Constitution of India**, specifically **Article 21**, which ensures the right to **life and personal dignity**.
 
• The court directed all **municipal corporations** and **local bodies** in major cities to transition completely to **mechanized cleaning** processes. This includes the deployment of **robotic scavengers** and specialized machinery to eliminate the need for human entry into hazardous sewer environments.
